semantics: StoreController generates each row request at base+row_counter*configured_stride; destination stride does not change the full-width accumulator/scale/writer path.
admission: column extent equals physical array width
row count positive and at most array width
explicit streamed readout and request-stage opt-ins
preserved: existing stage costs and resource capacities
unsupported: Partial, unaligned, overlapping, pooling or narrow/scaled outputs remain on previous approximation; they gain no new qualification.
case_role: Both32-cubed cases guided this geometry refinement and are development evidence, not independent final validation.
